=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
Requirement: "HEAL_SCOPE_GUARD_TEST_SUBJECTS maps the CI contract guards to ci.yml." (PR DESCRIPTION, item 11; agents.md says "Guard tests check other files, so their own name maps to no subject; HEAL_SCOPE_GUARD_TEST_SUBJECTS maps them to the files their fix edits".)
Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py::HEAL_SCOPE_GUARD_TEST_SUBJECTS (lines 2158–2163)
Evidence of absence: The map covers tests/test_ci_job_split_contract.py and tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py (the latter added in the LAST RUN DIFF) but omits tests/test_ci_inventory_parity_order_contract.py and tests/test_ci_shared_shell_block_guard.py. Both files exist, both load CI_WF = REPO_ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / "ci.yml" as their primary subject (test_ci_inventory_parity_order_contract.py:16 and test_ci_shared_shell_block_guard.py:17), and neither stem (`ci_inventory_parity_order_contract`, `ci_shared_shell_block_guard`) resolves to ci.yml through heal_scope_test_subjects's standard `scripts/<stem>.{sh,py}` / `.github/workflows/<stem>.yml` / `.github/workflows/<stem-with-dashes>.yml` candidates (none of those files exist in the repo). The test added by the LAST RUN DIFF (test_ci_poll_sharding_guard_scopes_ci_and_both_release_gates) and the existing test_size_guard_threshold_matches_the_guard_test both verify entries that *are* in the map; no test catches the missing ones. When either guard test fails, heal-scope render returns a marker that lists only workflow_paths + tests/** + changelog.d/*.md (the guard test's own file is covered by tests/** but ci.yml is not), so the heal cannot edit ci.yml — the same confined-to-tests failure mode item 11 was introduced to fix.
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
Requirement: "HEAL_SCOPE_GUARD_TEST_SUBJECTS maps the CI contract guards to ci.yml."
Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py::HEAL_SCOPE_GUARD_TEST_SUBJECTS
Evidence of absence: The map at lines 2158-2163 covers test_ci_job_split_contract.py and test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py but omits tests/test_ci_inventory_parity_order_contract.py (which reads ci.yml at line 15 as CI_WF) and tests/test_ci_shared_shell_block_guard.py (which reads ci.yml at line 17 as CI_WORKFLOW). Both are CI contract guards whose test stems (test_ci_inventory_parity_order_contract, test_ci_shared_shell_block_guard) do not resolve to ci.yml through the normal stem-to-subject mapping in heal_scope_test_subjects. When either guard test fails, the frozen heal scope therefore lacks .github/workflows/ci.yml, preventing the heal from editing the workflow it checks. The existing test test_size_guard_threshold_matches_the_guard_test verifies that every key in the map is a real test file, but does not verify that every CI contract guard is in the map.
SEVERITY: MAJOR
